name: Knockout wipe
description: A slanted cut with a bright edge sweeping across a picture, knocking its background out to a transparency checkerboard and leaving the cut-out standing, like a background-removal reveal. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: App window
description: A neo-brutalist app window with a coloured title bar, three dots and a hard offset shadow springing in at a tilt, its progress ring filling and drawing a tick as the label changes to done.

name: Slime drop
description: A drippy slime title falling in from above, squashing flat as it lands in a puddle and splashing droplets out round it that stay as specks.

name: Before and after
description: Two pictures compared either side of a divider with a round handle that follows the pointer while it hovers and sweeps back and forth when idle; a cut-out shows over a transparency checkerboard.

name: Swoosh underline
description: A glowing curved stroke sweeping on under a subtitle with a bright head and a thinner second stroke chasing it, then wiping away from its tail; a transparent overlay.

name: Tick ring burst
description: A sunburst arc of short rounded ticks popping out one after another from its middle behind a title, holding, then flying outward and fading; a transparent overlay.

name: Orbit swoosh
description: Glowing comet ribbons circling a title on tilted orbits, dimming and slipping behind it on the far side, shedding flecks of confetti that drift out and fade; a transparent overlay.

name: Spider web loader
description: A spider web weaving itself spoke by spoke and round its spiral, then a spider dropping in on its thread, bobbing, and climbing back out as the web fades.

name: Plexus web
description: A web of glowing points drifting in the dark, each strung to its neighbours by fine lines that brighten as they close in and fade as they part.

name: Web shot
description: A line of silk shoots from the bottom of the frame to every click and bursts into a sticky web splat that hangs there, then fades.

name: Cobweb corners
description: Dusty, tattered cobwebs strung across the corners of the frame, their threads sagging and gently stirring, with loose strands hanging down: a spooky overlay for a page or picture.

name: Spider web
description: An orb web strung across the frame, spokes and a spiral of straight silk threads swaying in the breeze, beaded with glinting dew over soft out-of-focus leaves.

name: Corner pin
description: A picture pinned by its four corners anywhere in the frame, in true perspective, for screen replacements, signs and mock-ups.

name: Word pop
description: Social-video captions: each word in turn pops on from small with a quick tilt, then snaps to rest, lit in a highlight colour until the next word lands. Earlier words stay.

controls.d: Captions that pop on every word

texts.name: text
texts.label: Text
texts.default: Captions that pop on every word

name: Karaoke sweep
description: A caption shown whole in an outlined base colour, with a highlight colour wiping left to right across it a word at a time, like karaoke lyrics.

name: Word bounce
description: A caption's words spring up one after another, each overshooting in scale with an elastic wobble before it settles.

name: LUT grade
description: A colour grade from a 3D LUT image (or a built-in teal & orange, punchy or film noir look) that leaves skin tones alone, so faces keep their colour under a heavy grade.

Look without a LUT (1 teal & orange, 2 punchy, 3 film noir)

images.label: LUT image (n³ colours: n × n tiles, or Hald)

name: Chroma key
description: A green- or blue-screen keyer: the screen turns clear (or the backdrop colour) with a soft edge, the screen colour bounced onto the subject is taken back out, and shadows cast on the screen can stay as see-through shade.

name: Iridescent text
description: A title in rainbow chrome: thin-film colours swirl over bevelled letters with bright white rims, a soft rainbow halo, and star glints twinkling at the edges.

name: Neon warp
description: Pink and cyan light streaks rushing out from a dark centre, as if jumping to hyperspace, leaving room in the middle for a title.
